We are not looking for candidates with extensive experience so much as excellent organisers and communicators. Responsibilities: coordinate monthly reports and schedule meetings and interviews; organise international company events; manage suppliers and stakeholders. What we are looking for: excellent communication skills; a degree in a business or technical subject; ability to travel up to four times a year. During this application process I agree to use only my own words. Plagiarism, the use of AI or other generated content will disqualify my application.
